Title: Project skeleton: backend, DB (SQLite/MySQL), frontend, seeded users
User Story: As a developer, I want the app skeleton running so features can be added.
Acceptance Criteria: App runs locally; DB has users and change_requests tables.

Title: Login (username/password)
User Story: As a user, I want to log in.
Acceptance Criteria: Valid login gives access; invalid is rejected.

Title: Role-based menus (Requester, CAB, Implementer, Admin)
User Story: As an admin, I want features shown by role.
Acceptance Criteria: Each role sees only its own actions.

Title: Submit a change request (simple form)
User Story: As a requester, I want to submit a CR with title, description, priority.
Acceptance Criteria: CR saved with ID and status Submitted.

Title: Risk level field (Low/Medium/High)
User Story: As a requester/CAB, I want a risk level on each CR.

Title: Rollback plan required when risk is High
User Story: As CAB, I want High-risk CRs to need a rollback plan.
Acceptance Criteria: Save blocked without rollback text if risk is High.

Title: List CRs and show status
User Story: As a requester, I want to see my CRs and their status.
Acceptance Criteria: Table of CRs with current status.

Title: Sprint 1 demo video (1 min) in /demo
User Story: As a team, we want a short Sprint 1 demo video.

Title: Approve or reject a CR with comment
User Story: As CAB, I want to approve or reject with a comment.
Acceptance Criteria: Decision and comment saved; status changes.

Title: GitHub Actions: build on every PR
User Story: As a team, we want automated build checks on PRs.

Title: Hash passwords
User Story: As an org, we want no plaintext passwords.

Title: Role check on API endpoints
User Story: As an org, we want server-side role checks.

Title: Request more info (extra decision option)
User Story: As CAB, I want to send a CR back for more info.

Title: Schedule date on approved CR + simple blackout-date check
User Story: As an approver, I want to set a date and be warned about blackout dates.
Acceptance Criteria: Blackout date is blocked or warned.

Title: Update implementation status
User Story: As an implementer, I want to set In Progress/Completed/Failed.

Title: Post-implementation notes
User Story: As an implementer, I want to add review notes.

Title: In-app notification on status change
User Story: As a requester, I want to be notified when status changes.

Title: Audit log of CR actions
User Story: As an auditor, I want actions logged.
Acceptance Criteria: Log row with user, action, time per CR action.

Title: Response time check (one quick test)
User Story: As a user, I want pages to respond fast.

Title: Final docs, deviations note, Sprint 2 demo video (2 min)
User Story: As a team, we want final docs and demo.
